description: This source file implements a benchmarking program for measuring the performance of image resize algorithms using the skia library. It generates bitmaps, applies resize methods, and reports throughput in MB/s.

classes.name: Dimensions
classes.description: Represents bitmap dimensions with validation and parsing from string.

classes.name: Benchmark
classes.description: Handles command-line parsing, setup, and execution of the resize performance benchmark.

methods.name: StringToMethod
methods.description: Converts a string to a skia::ImageOperations::ResizeMethod enum value.

methods.name: MethodToString
methods.description: Converts a resize method enum to its string representation.

methods.name: PrintMethods
methods.description: Prints all supported resize method names.

methods.name: GetBitmapSize
methods.description: Calculates the memory size of a bitmap based on height, width, and bytes per pixel.

methods.name: Dimensions::FromString
methods.description: Parses a string of format 'WxH' into width and height.

methods.name: Benchmark::ParseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure the benchmark.

methods.name: Benchmark::Run
methods.description: Performs the resize benchmark and reports throughput.

methods.name: Benchmark::Usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the benchmark program.
